recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No follow-up source work is recommended unless a future work group decision asks to strengthen the existing prose into an explicit SHALL statement or add validator-specific constraints.
issue_request: FHIR-25684 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-I clarification asking the narrative XHTML datatype page to state clearly that the root XHTML element for Narrative.div must be a div, not another legal XHTML element such as pre.
initial_application: The request was applied by source commit 450fc3172fe21051b0546ee6a5bbc8afe773d04b, which changed source/narrative.html so the xhtml table says the id property becomes xml:id on the root element which is an xhtml div and that JSON encodes the XHTML div.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini actively maps both narrative and xhtml type pages to source/narrative.html. The linked Zulip discussion records that the standard intended the root to be div and that a clarification task was appropriate, and the FHIR-I 2020-04-20 minutes record FHIR-25684 as Persuasive by 11-0-0.
reconciliation: No source files were changed because the current authoritative narrative page already contains the requested root-div clarification and no later evidence reversed or weakened it.
